title: Welcome to the Modern World of Pronouns: Identity-Inclusive Natural Language Processing beyond Gender

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the usage of neopronouns on Reddit and experimentally quantifying the performance trade-off in coreference resolution (using the OntoNotes 5.0 dataset) when applying a fairer, delexicalized approach that replaces all pronouns with part-of-speech tags to prevent exclusion of non-binary and novel pronouns.

Identifying the existence and usage of nounself and emojiself pronouns on Reddit to highlight the exclusion of otherkin identities in current NLP systems, and proposing delexicalization to accommodate open-class pronoun phenomena.
